maria: Day 4 check-in — quick update

What I did:
- Finished the 'runtime basics' module and the Redwood console tour.
- Set up my dev laptop, installed zsh + dotfiles, cloned monorepo, ran yarn bootstrap.
- Spun up local API and confirmed basic responses for toy model endpoint.

Blockers:
- Still can't run CI builds from my fork — SSO to our CI runner fails with `403` when the job tries to pull secrets.
- VPN drops intermittently which makes pushing branches flaky.
- Need approval for AWS read-only role to inspect some infra logs.

Tried:
- Reinstalled Okta and re-enrolled device.
- Confirmed my SSH key is in my profile.
- Ran `curl -v https://ci.redwood.example.com/health` and got a TLS handshake error intermittently.

Today:
- Pair with whoever can help with the CI 403 (pinging @chris).
- Re-run bootstrap and validate e2e locally.
- Do security training module 2 if I get the CI access resolved.

maria: Attach paste of `curl` output:
```
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1):
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2):

curl: (35) error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert certificate unknown
```

onboarding-bot: reminder: Please complete the 'Security & Data Handling' course by EOD Friday. https://learn.redwood/example/course/security :bell:

chris: hey @maria — thanks for the details. I just pinged infra with your job id. Two quick things to try in the meantime:
1) can you run `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste output? sometimes the runner rejects based on key vs SSO state.
2) try `curl --tls-max 1.2 -v https://ci.redwood.example.com/health` — if that succeeds it's likely a TLS negotiation edge with your machine's openssl.

chris: also, I'll ask infra to check the runner logs around the 403 you saw (include the job id in the ticket if you have it).

leo: I can pair at 3pm PT today if that helps — happy to walk through the onboarding CI flow and grant request process. LMK and I can send a calendar invite. :calendar:

tasha: @maria I reset an SSO session for your account and added a temporary rule to allow your IP to pull secrets for 1 hour — try the CI run again and let me know the job id if it still 403s. If VPN instability continues, send me the client logs and I'll escalate with networking.

maria: CI job retried and progressed to the test stage — still waiting on one flaky e2e, but no 403 anymore. Thanks @tasha and @chris.

chris: sweet — mark blocker cleared. If you hit the flaky e2e, check `packages/e2e/__fixtures__/timeout.json` and try increasing the timeout locally as a temporary measure.

leo: invite sent for 3pm PT — added notes to the invite for debugging steps so we don't waste time.

maria: will join at 3pm. Also will finish security course after pairing. Thanks everyone! :heart:
